Name: Opportunity
Definition: A condition upon which an organization may wish to capitalize to benefit its stakeholders.

Name: Descriptor
Definition: An evaluative characterization of a result that is qualitative, i.e., not subject to measurement on a numeric scale by observation and may be subject to human judgment.

Name: Threat
Definition: A condition that may negatively impact the achievement of a goal.

Name: Value
Definition: A principle that is important and helps to define the essential character of the organization.

Name: MeasurementInstance
Definition: A measurement at a point in time.

Name: Submitter
Definition: The person submitting the plan or report in StratML format.

Name: Category
Definition: The term selected from a controlled vocabulary in order to distinguish an item from others in its set.

Name: Strength
Definition: A positive aspect of an organization that may provide a competitive advantage.

Name: Role
Definition: A complex element containing other elements enabling the naming, description, and categorization of different kinds of interests individuals and groups may have in the achievement of goals and objectives.

Name: PointOfContact
Definition: The person or office to be contacted for further information or to submit comments.

Name: ManagementChallenge
Definition: A relatively difficult issue to be addressed or obstacle to be overcome in order to achieve an objective.

Name: Mission
Definition: A brief description of the basic purpose of the organization.

Name: Vision
Definition: A concise and inspirational statement implicitly relating an organization's purpose to its values, thus motivating its actions toward a future state it strives to achieve.

Name: Relationship
Definition: A conceptual association between two elements.

Name: Weakness
Definition: A negative aspect of an organization that may place it at a competitive disadvantage.
